title: Cosmic Galaxy Nebula Wallpaper
description: Deep space nebula imagery perfect for 4K wallpapers, science YouTube thumbnails, and meditation content backgrounds.

prompt.main: spiral galaxy viewed from above with bright cyan and magenta nebula clouds, billions of stars, dark matter dust lanes, hubble space telescope photograph, ultra high resolution deep space imagery, 8k uhd --ar 16:9 --v 6.1 --s 750

explained.why: High stylize for vivid cosmic colors. Lower values look washed out.

tutorial.intro: Galaxy imagery needs specific colors + specific reference. "Hubble telescope" + "cyan and magenta" = real-space feel.
steps: Subject: spiral galaxy viewed from above 鈥?specify view angle.
Colors: bright cyan and magenta nebula clouds 鈥?name two specific nebula colors.
Detail: billions of stars, dark matter dust lanes 鈥?scale + texture cues.

tutorial.tips: Hubble = real space colors. Without that reference, MJ defaults to fantasy purple.

faq.q: Why does my galaxy look like a video game?
faq.a: You forgot the Hubble reference. "Hubble space telescope photograph" forces real-photo treatment.
Use 16:9 or 21:9. Generate at high resolution; MJ v6.1 supports 2K+.

faq.q: How to get vivid nebula colors?
faq.a: Name the colors directly: "cyan and magenta" or "orange and blue". Vague "colorful" fails.
